chunks: And Jamil ibn Darraj narrated from al-Walid ibn Sabih, who said:

I became feverish in al-Madinah one day in the month of Ramadan, so Abu Abdullah عليه السلام sent to me a bowl in which there was vinegar and oil, and he said to me, ‘Break your fast and perform salat (prayer) while you are sitting.’

key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, the time of obligatory fasting
key_terms.قَاعِدٌ: sitting, indicating a seated prayer posture due to illness

ai.seo_question: When does illness allow breaking the fast in Ramadan and praying while seated?
ai.summary: This hadith indicates that illness can permit a person to break the fast in Ramadan. It also shows that when sickness affects one’s ability, salat (prayer) may be performed sitting.
